_comment: The built-in six badges every institute gets until it customises its catalogue. MUST stay identical to DEFAULT_BADGE_CONFIG.badges in frontend-admin-dashboard/src/routes/settings/-constants/badge-config.ts and frontend-learner-dashboard-app/src/services/badge-config.ts (a vitest in the admin app asserts this). Used server-side to (a) accept these ids on /learner/v1/sync-unlocks when an institute has no stored badge list and (b) materialise them before the first catalogue append so adding a custom badge never hides the defaults.
